criteria.criterion: In a verifier-like setting, run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, then `git status --short`. The status output is empty, and index.html exists under the cargo target directory's site/ folder rather than in the repository root.
criteria.evidence: I ran this in the verifier snapshot, where CARGO_TARGET_DIR points outside the work tree. The build printed 'wrote .../jobs/20261015-051600-458x/target/verify/site/index.html'. `git status --short` printed nothing, and `ls` of the repo root shows no site/ directory. A second `git status --short`, run after all the other commands, was also empty. This is a result about the snapshot only.

criteria.criterion: `cargo test -p xtask` passes. It includes a test that the default output directory is not inside the repository work tree. It also has a test that `--out` pointing inside the repo root, apart from the ignored target directory, is refused with a clear error. The existing build_writes_index_html test still passes.
criteria.evidence: 17 unit tests and 9 policy tests passed. Among them: the_default_output_is_in_the_target_directory_not_the_work_tree, an_output_inside_the_repository_root_is_refused_with_a_clear_error, and build_writes_index_html_at_the_output_root. Run by hand, `--out docs/tmpout` exited 1 with 'refusing to write the page to .../docs/tmpout: it is inside the repository work tree ... Use a directory under the cargo target directory ... or outside the repository'.
Both finished with no warnings and no diff. Athena's own run of clippy with -D warnings also passed.

criteria.criterion: .github/workflows/pages.yml uploads the new output directory, and its path matches the xtask default (for example `target/site`). The workflow stays a thin call into `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- site`.
criteria.evidence: upload-pages-artifact now uses `path: target/site`. The workflow does not set CARGO_TARGET_DIR, so this is the xtask default (root/target/site). The render step is still `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- site`, and the header comment was updated to match.

criteria.criterion: docs/design/explainer-site.md and the xtask usage text state where the page is written and why. The reason is that building must not change the verifier's snapshot. The old `/site` location is no longer described as the default.
criteria.evidence: explainer-site.md now says the page goes to `site/` in the cargo target directory, explains that a write into the work tree would change the verifier's snapshot, and says the xtask refuses an in-tree --out. The SITE_USAGE string in main.rs gives the same location and reason. The README was updated too. The only remaining 'site/index.html (gitignored)' text is a historical entry for a past release in CHANGELOG.md, which is correct to keep.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] has an entry saying building the explainer page no longer writes into the work tree, so a verifier's snapshot stays unchanged.
criteria.evidence: [Unreleased] has a new '### Fixed' entry: 'Building the explainer page no longer writes into the work tree, so a verifier's snapshot stays unchanged.' It goes on to describe the new location, the --out refusal and the Pages path.

findings.summary: Removing /site from .gitignore means an existing site/ directory left in a checkout from earlier builds now shows up as untracked.
findings.evidence: The diff deletes the `/site` ignore entry. Developers who built the page before this change still have site/index.html in their checkout, and `git status` will now list it until they delete it. Nothing tells them to.

findings.summary: The workflow's `target/site` is correct only while CI leaves CARGO_TARGET_DIR unset.
findings.evidence: The xtask default follows $CARGO_TARGET_DIR, but the upload path is hard-coded. They match today because the workflow does not set that variable.

summary: The change does what was asked, and I recommend accepting it. `cargo run -p xtask -- site` now writes index.html under the cargo target directory. In the verifier snapshot it wrote to the job's target/verify/site/, and `git status --short` stayed empty. The xtask refuses any --out inside the repository root, unless it is under the target directory, with a clear error; I confirmed this by running it with `--out docs/tmpout`. Unit tests cover the default location, the CARGO_TARGET_DIR override and the refusal. The cargo test, clippy and fmt runs I did (test limited to the xtask package) were all clean. The Pages workflow uploads target/site, which matches the default. The design doc, README, usage text and CHANGELOG state the new location and the reason, which is that building must not change a verifier's snapshot. Every changed file is on the deliverables list, and the snapshot check in athena-core and athena-git was not touched. There are two small findings. First, deleting the /site gitignore entry means an old site/ directory left in an existing checkout will now show as untracked. Second, the workflow's upload path is hard-coded, so it would stop matching if CI ever set CARGO_TARGET_DIR. All results come from the snapshot, not the real repository.
